name: 5602-sharedprefix-125m-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. V0: this commit predates V1, so there is no VLLM_USE_V1 to set.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=128, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 5120 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. streams equals `max-num-seqs`, so the engine holds one full resident batch per step; the operating point is saturation and is never raised.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: a shared 1024-token prefix (`prefix_count: 1`) carried by 100% of requests, a unique body of exactly 512 tokens, and an output of exactly 50 tokens. `request_format: plain` because OPT ships no chat template; temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, static seed 5602.
purpose: A small-model autocomplete service answering 128 concurrent short requests sharing one long instruction prefix on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.0-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not carry keys over from a later vLLM.

model: facebook/opt-125m
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
block-size: 16
enable-prefix-caching: true
use-v2-block-manager: true
max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enforce-eager: false
enable-chunked-prefill: false
swap-space: 4
